detail.longDescription: I made Agentless server management GUI over plain SSH. In Litedeck, we can show and download file, service, docker container, terminal and security, and resource monitoring. Because, I have some Raspberry pi4, mini pc(N97, N100), jetson nano but cockpit or other app install in the server, but I don't want that. My servers haven't lot of resource. so I made litedeck. And Claude or Codex install in server is heavy too. AI can connect to ssh but, I want to watch what AI's do. So I make to tracking AI and show graph view using my Litedeck mcp.
